[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided example user stories for the user's project, such as user registration, login functionality, and password recovery.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant offered tips and considerations for breaking down user stories into smaller tasks, estimating effort, prioritizing user stories, and reviewing the roadmap regularly.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant explained the importance of effort estimation and provided techniques such as Three-Point Estimation, Story Points, T-Shirt Sizing, and Hour Estimation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant emphasized the importance of involving the team in effort estimation and using historical data to inform estimates.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided a detailed example of applying the three-point estimation technique to the user story about user registration, including optimistic, most likely, and pessimistic estimates.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested that the user apply the three-point estimation technique to other user stories as well.  
[FACT] The user expressed a desire to have taken more notes on the topic of effort estimation discussed by Rachel at the workshop.
